title: Closed Loop Wash Rack System
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR COMBAT COMMAND.US AIR FORCES CENTRAL.FA5702  379 ECONS
description_text: Item Description – Portable Wash Rack Must include on and off ramp Must include pull through capabilities - unenclosed Must have inputs for water Must catch and separate oil and water i.e. have a oil-water sperator Needs to be 240/415V 50 hertz Must be at least 20 feet in width Must be rated to support 30,000 lbs Must be portable Must be delivered to W62G2T W1 AS DLA DIST SAN JOAQUIN 25600 S CHRISMAN ROAD, REC WHSE 57 TRACY, CA 95304-5000 Will require installation at Al Udeid Air Base to include site prep, utility hookup, and testing Quantity 1
